Important native memory/resource progress; leaving this issue OPEN because live-dialog/JNI/Compose/native-parent acceptance remains incomplete.

Actual leased DialogConfig.build/close,128 repeated no-parent configuration builds and destructor-reentrant registry tests were added (test-only hook, no production branch or public/JNI/native identity change). Immutable53e56c7e native/build inputs27 match own Git blobs and remain unchanged. Eight real native methods pass under Valgrind3.22 twice (same bodies; not16 unique), exit0/2s each; zero invalid-access/error contexts and definite/indirect loss, no suppressions. Compile-only25s/36.01s executions were zero tests.

The48bytes possibly lost and544 reachable at each test-process exit are preserved, not described as zero heap residue. The symbolized second diagnostic locates these allocations in std/libtest thread/mpmc CompletedTest initialization and std Unix stack-overflow thread-info initialization. Attribution describes observed stacks only; not a general runtime/lifetime waiver.

[Exact source/result/binary/runtime receipts and both original diagnostics](https://github.com/Apdelrahman1911/nativeCmpkit/tree/1ceb9d686aebfcc5893a5f90325296be41075ed0/docs/development/evidence/native-ownership-important-20261028). No parent/live native dialog was opened. Cancellation during show, actual Compose disposal/settings/relaunch/closed-window checks, and IO-023 native-parent retention/main-thread safety remain. No release-readiness/publication claim.

## Important worker/JNI cancellation fix — verified 2026-10-28

Commit [`97effbd7dfa39ef5010b0700666d76334512fff1`](https://github.com/Apdelrahman1911/nativeCmpkit/commit/97effbd7dfa39ef5010b0700666d76334512fff1) closes an owning admission gap: cancellation during synchronous JNI configuration creation previously could still proceed into show afterward. Both desktop pick/save now check cancellation before allocation, inside the claimed handle's try/finally after creation, and after use, retaining exactly-once destruction. Public packages/JNI descriptors are unchanged.

**Reviewed important results:** actual complete picker production/test compilation and fresh selected `:calf-file-picker:desktopTest` passed **7/7**, two XML, zero failures/errors/skips, exit0/42.01s on Gradle9.7.1/JDK17/Linux. All795 before/after inputs match this immutable commit. Five methods use actual IO workers/cancellation with counted handles; two additional methods cross the actual packaged Linux JNI to create/query/destroy configurations and reject stale IDs. A directory configuration's file query cannot open a file modal, including on admission regression. The host native payload/source manifest and checksum were verified. Disclosed standalone negative control fails3/5; repaired standalone5/5 overlaps the seven Gradle methods, not12 unique tests.

[Source/results/limits](https://github.com/Apdelrahman1911/nativeCmpkit/blob/development/preview-hardening/docs/development/evidence/picker-cancellation-important-20261028/gradle003/important-result-review.json).

**Issue remains open:** these checks do not satisfy live Compose disposal/settings changes, immediate launch, config-build/show under a sanitizer, visible-dialog window close, or native parent/thread ownership. Cancellation racing after the guard can still enter a synchronous OS modal; no interruptible-modal promise. Prior native Valgrind findings/residue and IO-023 remain preserved. No release gate or platform coverage is waived.
